integration.title: Accurate Online Integration
integration.subtitle: Enter Accurate Online API credentials per company branch.
integration.infoText: API Token + HMAC-SHA256 signature flow. Get credentials from Area Developer.
integration.clientIdHelper: Client ID from Accurate Developer Area
integration.clientSecretHelper: Client Secret from Accurate Developer Area
integration.saveWarning: Credentials are stored encrypted in the backend database. Each branch can have different credentials.
integration.flowDescription: API Token + HMAC-SHA256 signature → /api/api-token.do → host → data API

resend.title: Email Integration (Resend)
resend.subtitle: Global configuration — used to send Analisis alert digest emails (task016) to all companies.
resend.infoText: One configuration applies system-wide (not per branch). Emails are sent automatically when the Analisis alert scheduler finds a customer performance drop.
resend.apiKeySetHelper: API Key is already saved. Fill this in only if you want to replace it.
resend.senderEmailHelper: Must be from a domain verified in Resend
resend.appBaseUrlHelper: Used as the source link in the email footer
resend.activeHelper: When disabled, notifications still appear in-app but no email is sent.

appSettings.title: Application Settings
appSettings.subtitle: Changes are applied instantly and saved automatically.
appSettings.languageHelper: Language choice is saved automatically and applies to the entire application.
appSettings.themeHelper: Theme choice is saved automatically and applies to the entire application.
appSettings.darkModeDesc: Dark theme — reduces eye strain in low-light environments
appSettings.lightModeDesc: Light theme — better visibility in bright environments
appSettings.paletteHelper: Choose an accent color for buttons and highlights. Saved to your account and applied wherever you log in.

pageSettings.title: Page Visibility
pageSettings.subtitle: Toggle menu visibility. Hidden pages show 'Under Maintenance'.

features.subtitle: Enable or disable pages and features per environment

buThreshold.title: Dormant Threshold per Business Unit
buThreshold.subtitle: Number of months without a transaction before a customer is considered dormant. Each Business Unit can have a different policy.
buThreshold.tooltip: Customer whose last_invoice_date is older than this threshold (from the selected period) is marked as Dormant.
buThreshold.b2bProjectDesc: Dormant threshold for B2B Project (months) — longer project cycle

kpiTarget.tooltip: Minimum target percentage for each KPI. Used as the reference for indicator colors on the dashboard.
kpiTarget.sectionSubtitle: Target value used as the green / yellow / red color threshold for KPI indicators.
kpiTarget.repeatOrderDesc: Minimum percentage of existing customers who must repeat order within 30 days
kpiTarget.dormantAlertDesc: If Dormant Rate is above this value, the M8 chart shows a red (warning) zone
kpiTarget.reactivationMinDesc: M10 target lower bound — BulletChart yellow zone starts from this value
kpiTarget.reactivationIdealDesc: M10 target upper bound — BulletChart green zone starts from this value

generalSection.title: General Settings
generalSection.activeWindowDesc: Active window in months: a customer is considered active if there is a transaction within the last N months
generalSection.enforcementDesc: "On" means non-superadmin users are restricted to their assigned branch/division; "Off" means only company scope applies
generalSection.accurateSyncDesc: Controls the "Sync Now" button on the Import page. When off, the button is disabled and users see a note explaining that automatic sync is not yet available.

periodInfo.title: About Period Month (period_month)
periodInfo.body: The period_month defaults to the current month automatically. Users can override it via the date filter on each workbench page (Customer 360, Dormant Customer, etc.). Status calculations (active / new / dormant) are always relative to the selected period.
